name: Thunder Ridge
summary: Thunder Ridge lies southwest of Orgrimmar, where thunder lizards roam a stripped canyon. Along the Southfury River in western Durotar, the former grove was ruined by human logging and dark sorcery. Agitated beasts and lingering cultists threaten nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Scarred Sanctuary
sections.body: Thunder Ridge was once a green haven in arid Durotar, shaded by ancient trees. Shortly after the Third War, humans from Kul Tiras began felling its timber. The thunder lizards grew wild as their home was cut away. Then the Burning Blade used fel sorcery to destroy what remained of the canopy. Now the gorge lies barren and exposed, with angry, lightning-spewing beasts roaming through it.

sections.title: Cultists and Tests of Strength
sections.body: Orgrimmar's people watch the ridge with care. The Burning Blade keeps a band of cultists there, led by the warlock Fizzle Darkclaw, whose demonic magic spreads chaos through Durotar. Horde veterans such as Orgnil Soulscar send scouts to hunt the cultists. Warrior trainers like Uzzek also send aspiring fighters into the crags to test themselves against the enraged thunder lizards.

faq.q: What happened to the trees in Thunder Ridge?
faq.answer: Thunder Ridge was once dense woodland, but two waves of destruction stripped it away. Shortly after Durotar was founded, Kul Tiran forces felled the ancient trees for lumber. Later, the Burning Blade used dark, demonic magic to raze the surviving groves and wipe out the forest.

faq.q: Why are the thunder lizards so aggressive here?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards once lived peacefully among Thunder Ridge's ancient trees. Human logging brought noise and destruction to their home, and lingering fel corruption from the Burning Blade cultists worsened their agitation. Now they attack anyone who enters the canyon.

Fizzle Darkclaw leads a Burning Blade cult and established an encampment in Thunder Ridge. He and his followers use dark rituals to destabilize the region, and Horde leaders such as Orgnil Soulscar have placed a bounty on his head.

faq.q: Did Rexxar fight in Thunder Ridge?
faq.answer: Yes. Shortly after Durotar was founded, Rexxar came to Thunder Ridge to gather shimmerweed for the farseer Drek'Thar. He found the human lumber camp driving the lizards wild, then culled the frenzied beasts and salvaged their eggs for Drek'Thar to study.

angles.text: Warrior mentors such as Uzzek send their trainees into Thunder Ridge to test their defensive skill against the strength and lightning shocks of wild thunder lizards.
Just beyond Orgrimmar's western bluffs, Thunder Ridge must be kept clear of Burning Blade agents such as Fizzle Darkclaw, whose demonic schemes threaten the capital.
